    31  ## Theorems
    32  
    33  The main theorems proved ensure that `CliffordAlgebra Q` satisfies the universal property
    34  of the Clifford algebra.
    35  1. `ι_comp_lift` is the fact that the composition of `ι Q` with `lift Q f cond` agrees with `f`.
    36  2. `lift_unique` ensures the uniqueness of `lift Q f cond` with respect to 1.
    37  
    38  ## Implementation details
    39  
    40  The Clifford algebra of `M` is constructed as a quotient of the tensor algebra, as follows.
    41  1. We define a relation `CliffordAlgebra.Rel Q` on `TensorAlgebra R M`.
    42     This is the smallest relation which identifies squares of elements of `M` with `Q m`.
    43  2. The Clifford algebra is the quotient of the tensor algebra by this relation.
    44  
    45  This file is almost identical to `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/ExteriorAlgebra/Basic.lean`.
    46  -/
